TAL_WEATHER_WEATHERPROOF_MANTLE.why: One purchase is for one Weather Sign ('Choose one Weather Sign talent you know ... choosing a different Weather Sign each time'): the sign is asked once and kept on the owner, so a Mantle of another sign gains nothing from it. That sign's named Resistance is put on the mantled creature as condition rule data, read by the shared damage_defenses path (combat/ext/standard_conditions.py); Wind's 'Resistance to nonmagical ranged weapon damage' is answered through the same damage_defenses seam because it is about the attack rather than the damage type; Dry's 'necrotic damage from desiccation' is stated for the table; and the printed Advantage on saves against cold weather (Heat) and dehydration (Dry) rides the save hook.

TAL_WEATHER_WEATHER_BACKLASH.why: A melee hit on a creature carrying one of your Sky Mantles burns the attacker for your Proficiency Bonus, typed by the Mantle's sign and once per round per mantled creature (combat/ext/weather_mantle.py, after_hit).

TAL_WEATHER_SHARED_WEATHER_FAVOR.why: The printed extra willing recipients of a Sky Mantle, all on the same sign, are compiled as extra choose_willing recipients on the cast (combat/ext/weather_mantle.py, compile_actions); each recipient is asked through the ordinary consent transport.

TAL_WEATHER_PERSISTENT_SHROUD.why: 2 additional Cultivation Points for a Shroud that lasts without Concentration and ends after the target's three successful saves; at Mortal Realm only one of yours may be active (combat/ext/weather_shroud.py, compile_actions and compile_resources).

TAL_WEATHER_PRESSURE_CRACKING_SHROUD.why: 2 Cultivation Points on a failed save against your Cloud Shroud take away the target's Resistance to that Shroud's damage type until the end of your next turn (combat/ext/weather_shroud.py, Pressure-Cracking Shroud).

TAL_WEATHER_LIGHTNING_CHOOSES_THE_ROD.why: Move your Thunder Shroud to another creature within 30 feet of the original target without using an action, once per round; the new target makes the Shroud's saving throw at once (combat/ext/weather_shroud.py, Move Thunder Shroud).

TAL_WEATHER_QUICK_MANTLE.why: The Sky Mantle cast as a Bonus Action, and one free combat cast per short rest, are compiled as extra casts of the base ability (combat/ext/weather_mantle.py, compile_actions) with an evented allowance for the free cast.

TAL_WEATHER_LINGERING_MANTLE.why: 2 additional Cultivation Points for a cast that lasts its remaining duration without Concentration, with one of yours at a time at Mortal Realm (combat/ext/weather_mantle.py, compile_actions and the weather_sky_mantle effect).
